name: strategic-compact
title: Strategic Compact
description: Suggests manual context compaction at logical task-phase boundaries, so long sessions compact deliberately instead of at arbitrary auto-compaction points.
why: Long agent sessions die at context limits; compacting at phase boundaries keeps the working thread coherent across a whole build.
adaptations: Ships a Claude Code-specific PreToolUse hook (suggest-compact.js); the compaction guidance itself is harness-portable.
